current_bottleneck: Direct raw future-path likelihoods are too high-dimensional for the available data, while 392a wrappers preserve geometry but cannot learn conditional level/regime allocation. The next clean bottleneck is whether a learned narrow future-path manifold makes the conditional full-path law learnable.
last_result_summary: 475 selected a new learned-core paradigm: train a deterministic empirical-normal-score future-path autoencoder, then train a vanilla conditional latent flow from history to the compact future-path latent. This uses only the allowed narrow encoder-decoder bottleneck and avoids calibration wrappers, low-rank readouts, bounded side paths, retrieval, and validation-future oracle information.
next_step_recommendation: Implement the first minimal latent path-manifold flow falsifier and evaluate it on reconstruction diagnostics plus the unchanged full 11-suite. Kill the branch if reconstruction cannot preserve path geometry or if conditional latent sampling repeats the direct-path collapse.
current_best_note: Ties the official revised-suite 8/11 frontier with better residual geometry than 385a: level KS 10/25, median-bias fraction 20/25, bias magnitude 25/25, daily KS 25/25, conditionality pass, and cointegration pass. Architecture is unchanged; the change is a theoretically proper free-running path-energy score fine-tune anchored by FM.
oracle_feasibility_note: 435a reaches 11/11 only as a validation-future oracle upper bound; it is not a deployable or learned conditional scenario generator.
